insight: Grounds every extracted field in a clickable citation back to the source document, so reviewers can audit each AI answer's provenance.
name: V7 Go
tagline: Agentic AI that automates document-heavy knowledge work and data extraction.
description: An operational AI platform from V7 Labs that builds and runs agents over complex documents — extracting financial, legal, and commercial terms, completing DDQs, and generating memos with source traceability. It chains foundation models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google into multi-step, auditable workflows aimed at finance, insurance, legal, and real-estate teams.
